text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
TWEENDECKERS - Trust 38 - (built 1974) 15,172 dwt sold for $1.45 million including twelve months timecharter at $4,500 daily.
Hawk One - (built 1983) 14,900 dwt sold to Vietnamese buyers for $4.45 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Vitajoy - (built 1971) sold to Indian breakers for $152.5 per ldt.
Aristo 1 - (built 1969) 13,318 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $174.5 per ldt.
Port Talbot - (built 1970) 81,612 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $147 per ldt.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
